u2-l1#odkial-si.picture: Emma arrives at the dormitory with a backpack and a suitcase with a shamrock sticker. Lucia, her new roommate, opens the door of their room to her with a welcoming gesture, and asks where she's from.

u2-l1#som-z-irska.picture: A green map of Ireland with Emma standing in the middle of it, smiling: this is where she's from.

u2-l1#lucia-je-zo.picture: A green map of Slovakia with Lucia standing on it near Bratislava, smiling: this is where she's from.

u2-l1#nemecko-taliansko-polsko.picture: Close-up of the map of Europe on the dorm wall, with coloured pins stuck in Germany, Italy and Poland; Emma's hand is pushing in the last one.

u2-l1#som-z-ukrajiny.picture: At the university's international students' evening, Oksana stands at a table decorated with a blue-and-yellow Ukrainian flag and introduces herself, a hand on her chest.

u2-l1#som-irka.picture: At the same international evening, Emma stands proudly at the table with the Irish tricolour, a plate of soda bread in front of her.

u2-l1#slovak-slovenka.picture: At the international evening, Tomáš and Lucia stand side by side at the table with the Slovak flag, a Slovak man and a Slovak woman, offering little plates of homemade food.

u2-l2#grammar-ty-or-vy.picture: Split picture of two pairs crossing the campus. Left: Lucia and Tomáš walk together, a man and a woman. Right: Lucia and Emma walk together, two women.

u2-l2#choice-odkial-ste.picture: After class, Emma stands at pani Horváthová's desk and asks her something politely; the teacher, packing up her books, turns to answer with a smile.

u2-l3#co-je-to.picture: In Bratislava's Old Town, Emma, new in the city, points up at the white castle with four corner towers on its hill and turns to Lucia with a curious, questioning look.

u2-l3#kto-je-to.picture: Emma and Lucia sit on a park bench. Tomáš walks up with a friend Emma doesn't know, Marek; Emma leans towards Lucia and asks quietly who that is.

u2-l4#ja-tiez.picture: In the Slovak classroom before the lesson, Oksana tells Emma something about herself; Emma points at herself with a delighted smile: me too!

u2-l5#choice-prepacte-nerozumiem.picture: At the dormitory's front desk, Emma checks in with her passport in hand. Pán Kováč, typing at the computer, asks her something very fast; Emma looks lost and apologetic.

u2-l5#mozete-mi-pomoct.picture: In a narrow Old Town street, Emma holds an unfolded city map and looks lost; she politely approaches the woman with the shopping bag to ask for help.

u2-l6#kolko-mas-rokov.picture: In the dorm common room, Marek lounges in an armchair with his hands behind his head; Emma, sitting forward on a chair, asks him with a teasing smile how old he is.

u2-l6#prvy-druhy-treti.picture: After a university fun run, Tomáš, Lucia and Emma stand on a winners' podium: Tomáš on the top step, Lucia second, Emma third, all laughing and out of breath.

u2-telefon#halo.picture: Split picture of a phone call. Left: in the dorm room, Lucia picks up her ringing phone and answers, curious who it is. Right: Emma calls her from a street in the Old Town, smiling.

u2-telefon#telefonovat.picture: Tomáš leans back in his office chair with his feet up on his untidy desk, chatting away on the phone and waving his free hand as he talks.

u2-telefon#telefonne-cislo.picture: After class, in the corridor outside the classroom, Oksana asks Emma for her phone number and types it into her phone as Emma reads it out.

u2-telefon#zavolam-ti.picture: Evening at a tram stop: Lucia, stepping onto the tram, turns in the doorway and holds a hand to her ear like a phone; Emma, staying behind on the platform, nods and waves.

u2-telefon#dopocutia.picture: Emma, at her desk in the dorm room, finishes a phone call: she says goodbye with a warm smile and takes the phone from her ear to hang up.
